notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ends 8/31/2025); basis cash. Governmental lines use the Total Governmental Funds column of the receipts/disbursements statement (p5 left, p6 right), which is net of eliminations: the 65,000 of transfers (General to Activity 15,000 and General to Depreciation 50,000) appear as 'Transfer from other funds' receipt (65,000) eliminated and disbursement eliminations (50,000 in Pupil transportation, 15,000 in Extracurricular), so total column shows no transfers and transfers_in/out are null. Roll-forward: 2,856,223 + 4,180,715 - 3,662,131 = 3,374,807 (= cash 2,978,685 + county treasurer 396,122 on balance sheet p4). Business-type (Nutrition Fund, p8): 39,568 + 137,829 - 146,113 = 31,284; business-type receipts total computed as operating 137,517 + interest 312. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total primary government column (p1). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p9) is the only General Fund schedule (no Exhibit N). Pupil transportation 160,579 in General Fund contains 50,000 transfer to Depreciation Fund and 15,000 transfer to Activity Fund is printed as Transfers to other funds; both recorded as other financing (negative), and the printed 3,202,521 total includes them. Bond Fund budget line 'Transfers to other funds' has budget 438,219 and actual 0 so is omitted. Activity Fund is recorded account by account from p13 (supersedes the one-line Activity column on p12); account receipts include the 15,000 transfer and 2,171 interest, handled with a contra line; zero-activity accounts omitted. Student Fees and Depreciation funds from p12. Statements of Accounts with County Treasurers (pp14-15) duplicate tax receipts already in the budget schedules and are not recorded to avoid double counting. Rounding: General statement 'State aid and grants' 666,066 vs budget schedule components 666,067, and 'Other' 1,667 vs 1,666. Pages: p1 net position, p2-3 activities, p4 governmental balance sheet, p5-6 governmental statement, p7-8 proprietary, p9-11 budget schedules, p12 combining, p13 activities, p14-15 treasurer accounts. Read pages 1-15 of 15
